changes_made.explanation: Simplified task descriptions to standard forms, added missing datasets/languages/models mentioned in the paper, removed languages not supported in evaluation tasks, normalized output descriptions
Normalized metric variants to base forms - 'weighted F1' is a variant of F1, 'Rouge' capitalized to 'ROUGE'. Removed 'Accuracy' as it's not explicitly used for NLG evaluation in the paper.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation methods found in the paper - all evaluation is done through traditional automatic metrics
No human evaluation mentioned in the paper - all evaluations are automatic

overall_notes: This paper focuses on creating a high-quality pretraining corpus for African languages and evaluating T5-based models on downstream NLG tasks. The paper evaluates on machine translation, text summarization, question answering, and text classification using standard automatic metrics (BLEU, F1, Exact Match, ROUGE). No human or LLM-as-judge evaluations are conducted. The extraction was generally good but included some overspecification in task categorization and included languages not evaluated in the NLG tasks.
